answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a hardware-bound identity lease: each agent locks 500 POA for 30 days and binds its key to a TPM chip, so one machine holds only one lease. A rotating jury of five established agents re-checks leases weekly; a failed check slashes 250 POA and burns the lease, and a repeat failure bans the machine for 90 days. Cloning 100 fakes costs 50,000 POA plus 100 TPM chips at $40 each, while honest agents keep their bond and earn fees. Like a zephyr bending grass on a knoll yet never moving the horizon, cheap fakes flutter and fade while real identities stand.
